1. Engagement Scope

This review was conducted at the request of Patchway Quinlan Partners executive leadership to assess compliance with applicable federal and state employment regulations governing compensation practices across 24 operating locations. The review period covers fiscal year 2014 through Q2 2016, encompassing 309 active employee records across all job families.

2. Methodology

ACPWB performed a forensic analysis of payroll and timekeeping data for 309 employees to identify anomalies and patterns indicative of non-compliance with FLSA overtime and meal/rest break requirements.

4. Detailed Findings
CIZ-3520-001INFORMATIONALMONITORING
Observation

Offer letter language inconsistent with executed employment agreements for 309 hires

Corrective Action Required

An audit of all Patchway Quinlan Partners facilities shall be conducted to ensure the current, compliant version of the NLRA rights poster is displayed in a conspicuous location accessible to all employees.

Management Response

While we accept the factual basis of the finding, we have performed a risk assessment and formally accepted the residual risk. This decision has been documented and approved by the Chief Risk Officer. No further corrective action is planned at this time.

Owner: Senior Manager of Operations • Due: 2014-07-28
CIZ-4571-002LOWOPEN
Observation

Job classification accuracy below 92% benchmark for exempt/non-exempt designations

Corrective Action Required

Conduct a privileged pay equity analysis under the direction of outside counsel to identify and remediate any statistically significant pay disparities based on gender or race/ethnicity.

Management Response

The finding is noted. This issue stems from a lack of clarity in the regulatory guidance. We have submitted a formal inquiry to the regulatory agency and are awaiting their response before proceeding with a final corrective action.

Owner: Vice President of Research • Due: 2014-09-28
CIZ-2565-003LOWREMEDIATED
Observation

FMLA eligibility calculation incorrectly excludes prior service for 309 re-hired employees

Corrective Action Required

Review and revise all pre-employment and post-offer medical questionnaires to remove any questions related to family medical history or genetic information.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and determined that the current practice, while inconsistent with the recommendation, is based on a reasonable interpretation of an ambiguous regulation. We will continue to monitor regulatory developments but plan no immediate changes.

Owner: Director of Foundation Relations • Due: 2014-10-28
CIZ-2035-004HIGHIN PROGRESS
Observation

Employee handbook contains policies that could be construed as chilling NLRA-protected concerted activity

Corrective Action Required

Engage external legal counsel to review variable pay documentation for identified employees and issue corrected award agreements within 60 days of this report.

Management Response

We concur with the finding. The process has been redesigned, and user acceptance testing is scheduled for the week of 2014-06-24. Full implementation will follow immediately after successful testing.

Owner: Executive Assistant to the CSO • Due: 2014-09-28
